snippet.title: RB Axolotl Cinematic Trailer (2020)
snippet.description:
There is a full length hour and a half demo on the steam store! https://store.steampowered.com/app/1014580/RB_Axolotl/ and wishlist us too, if you'd like! Wishlisting really helps indie games a ton.

If you want to join the official RB: Axolotl discord, the link is https://discord.gg/au2UAyX
Twitter:
https://twitter.com/Actawesome

Trailer edited by KotoriMWorks.

Taking place in a tank suspended upon a cosmic wonderland, five axolotls appear one day from a mysterious, thundering void. They quickly learn they are able to speak with one another, and relationships are formed. However, something is off. Each axolotl seems to possess knowledge they should not know. Foods, and people, and places and concepts...

And obsessions.

Amid conspiracies, illness', fights to the death, VR headsets, and bizarre reality switching, a figure named [RB] seems to be pulling the strings behind it all.
